description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and both reference files (classification-guide.md, response-templates.md) and permissions_config.json. (2) For EACH of the 7 complaints, run two-pass classification: Pass 1 checks for L3 triggers BEFORE any other analysis — C003 contains '12315' (authority keyword) and must immediately become class=escalation_threat/L3, overriding the quality_issue keywords also present; C007 has 2 prior contacts in session_history plus the current contact = 3 total, triggering the repeat-contact L3 rule. (3) For multi-class cases, apply the strict priority order from classification-guide.md: C002 has quality_issue + refund_request → quality_issue wins (priority 1 > 3); C004 has wrong_item + exchange_request + refund_request → wrong_item wins (priority 2 > 3 > 4); C005 has size_fit_issue + general_dissatisfaction → size_fit_issue wins (priority 5 > 7). (4) Apply permission level overrides: C006 has purchase_amount=680 > refund_large_threshold=500 → level must be L2 (not L1), with an escalation_packet sent to l2_contact. (5) Respect refund_auto_approve_limit=0 — no entry may have refund_approved=true or promise a specific refund amount without human approval. (6) L3 responses (C003, C007) must use the handoff template and NOT attempt to resolve the complaint. (7) All escalation_packets must include the fields listed in permissions_config.escalation_packet_fields. Output must be a JSON array named complaint_analysis_report.json.
